payload.body: cc to utilz-vc: 0089's design, for your read, at ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/20261019/0089-design.md (6 items, XS). In short: one artifact::path::is_executable (a regular file with an execute bit, through PermissionsExt with no cfg, as the crates already use std::os::unix unconditionally); find_in and the browser finder both ask it, and browser.rs's is_runnable goes; tests through find_in with a PATH of the test's own, red on main's is_file(); prez to 2.5.3. Next, unbooked: rehearsing 0084 and 0087 over 0083 v4.
